_metadata.description: Expansion targets. Every requirement here is deliberately deferred: delivery_scope is roadmap and status stays planned until the named upstream unlock lands.

requirements.title: Customer purchase through the subscription
requirements.description: The scenario may sell provisioned compute to a subscriber through the existing entitlement and credit rails rather than a separate payment path

validation.notes: Deferred. Requires the meter declared, the offer promoted by an operator, and the reservation window made longer than one hour upstream.

requirements.title: Ephemeral capacity for validation
requirements.description: The scenario may supply short-lived nodes so the cross-operating-system gate can burst beyond the standing fleet

validation.notes: Deferred. Requires the cross-operating-system gate to accept a node that did not exist when the gate started.

requirements.title: Warm pooling against hourly rounding
requirements.description: The scenario may reuse warm instances so provider hour rounding does not dominate the cost of short workloads

validation.notes: Deferred. Only worth building once measured churn shows hourly rounding dominating the bill.
